# ==============================================================================
# Dailyfix Robots.txt
# Optimized for Google Search, Googlebot, Googlebot-Image, Bingbot & Search Console

# 1. Google Inspection Tool (for fast Google Search Console URL inspection & re-indexing)

Allow: /

# 2. Googlebot-Image (Full access to crawled favicons, logos, and images)

Allow: /

Allow: /favicon-96x96.png
Allow: /favicon-192x192.png
Allow: /apple-touch-icon.png
Allow: /logo.png
Allow: /dailyfix-logo.png
Allow: /dailyfix-logo.webp
Allow: /images/
Allow: /assets/

User-agent: Googlebot
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin
